name: zeffect_skip_conditional_chain_to_end
description: zEffect::SkipConditionalChainToEnd advances the current event pointer until the conditional-chain end marker is reached.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native conditional-chain event tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x45c6b0 validates repeated byteSize advancement through the current event stream until event type 0x22 or stream end.
The native conditional-chain smoke verifies that the runtime current-event pointer advances across intermediate conditional events and stops on the chain-end marker while returning 2.
